## Background

I am currently studying Strategic Management at the BYU Marriott School of Business, with a focus on product- and project-oriented work at the intersection of business, design, and emerging technology. Through coursework and hands-on projects, I have learned to approach problems by first understanding users and context, then translating those insights into scalable systems, tools, and experiences.

My interest in product management comes from turning ambiguity into clarity. I enjoy defining problems, collaborating across disciplines, and building thoughtful solutions that reduce friction and create real value. I am especially drawn to products that empower users, leverage AI and automation, and are grounded in empathy and strong design.
